target: the same input estimated twice gives the same number, so a threshold decision is reproducible
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-small.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary 2>e1 >/dev/null; cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-small.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary 2>e2 >/dev/null; grep -qi estimate e1 && [ -s e1 ] && cmp -s e1 e2 && echo DETERMINISTIC
_note: Requires e1 to be non-empty AND contain an estimate: comparing two empty stderr streams is 'identical' for the wrong reason.
